summary: Flat round-end (stadium-shaped) aluminum pattern plate, 56 mm long, 32 mm wide and 2.5 mm thick. It has two large 14 mm through holes, one centered in each rounded end, and a field of smaller pattern holes between and around them.

mountingSurfaces.description: Top flat face, 56 x 32 mm, for mounting parts and bearings against the pattern holes
Bottom flat face, 56 x 32 mm, for mounting flush against rails, channel or other structure

notes: Length, width and thickness come from the listed specs, which are flagged as unverified. The 14 mm hole centers at x=±12 mm are inferred, not printed. They assume the 16 mm end radius (half the 32 mm width) and the stated 24 mm across-center spacing. The images show about 14 smaller pattern holes, some slotted, but no printed diameter or position for them, so they are left out of the holes array. The pattern is described as 16 mm goBILDA pattern. Z is centered on the plate midplane.
